chunks: What the Shaykh—may Allah, Most High, support him—informed me of, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī al-Washshāʾ, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Sinān, from Ḥafṣ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked him about one who had intercourse with his wife while she was menstruating. He said: “He should give charity of one dīnār and seek forgiveness from Allah, Most High.” This is to be understood as applying when the intercourse occurred at the beginning of menstruation. Do you not see toward...

key_terms.بِدِينَارٍ: with one dīnār; the specified amount of charity

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a man who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding intercourse with one's wife during menstruation, prescribing charity of one dīnār and seeking forgiveness from Allah, Most High. The appended statement indicates that this ruling is understood in relation to intercourse occurring at the beginning of the menstrual period.
